executive_risk_memo: Across the 2025-2026 observation window, World Chain Bridge AnchorStateRegistryProxy (0x90BB48fe3310499Db36437dCAE642F721e32d094) served as the dispute-game anchor state root verifier securing $220.5M in bridged TVL on Ethereum. Forensic analysis of its live control plane reveals that proxy admin authority is held by ProxyAdmin 0xd7405BE7f3e63b094Af6C7C23D5eE33Fd82F872D, which in turn is wholly owned by 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe 0xA4fB12D15Eb85dc9284a7df0AdBC8B696EdbbF1d with zero timelock latency or operational delay. Safe 0xA4fB...bF1d was originally initialized at a 3-of-8 threshold at deployment before rotating to its current 3-of-6 configuration. At block 25,830,641 (2026-08-25), the Safe executed transaction 0x3f6f4122d21807d82d176c92da0b7c9586821e97dbf54126ad9dfa0ec31618cf, migrating implementation bytecode to 0x8F40Cc98D694AB986F026C5383A181FCc9B6B281 instantly without prior timelock queueing. Documentation forensics identify a 277-day synchronization gap where official developer documentation (world-chain-contracts.mdx) published a superseded mainnet address (0xD4D7...7099) before being synchronized in commit 54b8dd44 via PR #159 on the day of the upgrade (MTTR = 277.0 days). Repository auditing of worldcoin/world-chain shows 718 commits over the trailing 12 months (60 Solidity/Vyper/Yul smart contract commits and 658 non-contract commits across 14 human engineers with a bus factor of 3). Core protocol risk concentrates in the 3-of-6 Safe threshold without an on-chain timelock buffer.
